== Release date of 7.1 Ultimate Power ==

The infobox and lead now give 18 June 2010 for Virtual Set 7.1 Ultimate Power. The earlier value was ~27 June 2010.

Evidence:
* The release PDF cover reads "Official text as of June 18, 2010" ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf VirtualBlock7_1.pdf]).
* The forum thread [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36308 Ultimate Power Rules Questions] opened at 01:33 UTC on 19 June 2010, which is the evening of 18 June in US time. Its first posts quote the new game text.
* The Holotable update thread [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36324 t=36324] asked for the Ultimate Power files on 19 June 2010.
* The star-wars.pl news item of 27 June 2010 is a later report, so the page now cites it for the report date only.

No separate announcement post for 7.1 turned up in a forum search. The Main Page and [[Virtual Legacy]] still give ~27 June 2010. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 18:18, 20 October 2026 (UTC)
